Your Barcelona week

What to expect before you arrive, during the course and between sessions.

Before you arrive

  • RegistrationWrite to us with the course and the week you want. A question is not a booking, and we confirm your place in writing.
  • Your venueClasses also run at Barceloneta, by the sea. We confirm which venue your week uses with your registration.
  • AccommodationYou book your own; it is not part of the course fee. Under Erasmus+, travel and accommodation come from your grant's own budget lines.
  • PaperworkTell us what your institution needs — invitation letter, acceptance letter or course description — and we send it before you travel.

An example week

Classes run Monday to Friday mornings. You choose 20 or 25 hours a week when you book, and the fee follows it. The cultural activities change from week to week; this is the pattern a Barcelona week usually follows.

MorningClass
AfternoonOld town walking tour

MorningClass
AfternoonMontjuïc and the Olympic Stadium

Friday

MorningClass
AfternoonAfternoon free

Two afternoons are given to the week's cultural activities. Both are included in the fee, both are optional, and someone from the team goes with the group.

The first day

You meet the trainer and the rest of the group at the venue confirmed with your registration. Course materials are handed out on the first day, matched to the levels in the room.

Small international groups. Participants usually come from several European countries in the same week.

Afternoons

Two afternoons are the week's cultural activities, and someone from the team goes with the group. The other afternoons are yours.

Practical information about the city →

At the end of the week

Your certificate of attendance is issued on the final day.

For the rest of the mobility paperwork, we provide:

  • Invitation letter
  • Pre-registration confirmation
  • Acceptance letter
  • Course description and programme
  • Certificate of attendance
  • Europass Mobility support
  • Invoice

Who to ask

Miriam coordinates the courses and Adriana handles registrations and paperwork. The same team is reachable before, during and after the week.
